name: BentoShuffleGallery
job: Show photos in an uneven tile layout where tiles trade places on click or on a timer, each photo getting its moment as the big feature with its details shown
visitor_action: tap a tile to make it the feature; the feature always shows its glass detail panel; otherwise the gallery rotates the feature by itself; arrow keys choose the feature
mobile: 2-column grid, tap enlarges one tile, feature shows details
motion: feature trade: outgoing tile lifts, winds up and sweeps on a bowed spring arc (tilt, deeper shadow) into the slot of the photo that grows into the 2x2 feature from the opposite bow; neighbours ripple away in its wake ; the detail panel fades in after each trade; hover only fades the caption and eases the photo (no layout change) (reduced-motion: no auto shuffle, instant swap on tap)
art_direction: Soft-UI bento: photo tiles raised from a cool grey-blue surface #e7eaf0 by paired light/dark shadows (no tray), dark-tinted glass caption chip (backdrop blur) with a periwinkle dot on quiet tiles (hover/focus only), and a larger dark glass detail panel (title, description, up to 3 meta pills) permanently on the feature tile, ink #232634, accent indigo #4a55c9, Bricolage Grotesque; pause control is a soft-UI button that inverts to inset when paused
